description: Get recent market changes: new listings, price cuts, price increases, homes that just sold, went pending, fell through, came back on the market, or were delisted. Filter by state, ZIP, or change type. Each event carries the Straply property ID, so follow up with get_property for full details and history. Use this for questions like 'what just sold in Austin?', 'any price cuts in 90210 this week?', or 'show me new listings in Texas'.

changeType.description: Filter to one kind of change. Omit for all market events. Comma-separate for several (e.g. 'price_cut,just_sold').

days.description: How many days of changes to include (1 = the most recent day)

includeAll.description: Include non-market data churn (mostly reference-price movement on off-market homes). Off by default — it is ~76% of raw changes and is rarely what a question is about.

name: get_recent_changes
title: Recent market changes
